notes.title: Great Update
notes.content:
In this update, we have some major changes:

- First, the training and combat sprites have been revamped.

- Steam services have been added. The game now has achievements that can be unlocked on Steam. (I'm working on creating ranked battles in the future.)

tags.feature: - First, the training and combat sprites have been revamped.
- Steam services have been added. The game now has achievements that can be unlocked on Steam. (I'm working on creating ranked battles in the future.)

notes.title: Update Note:
notes.content:
- A system of levels, experience (training - fights), and points per level has been created to develop strategies in fights as the rounds progress.
- Minor aesthetic improvements have been made to the menus.
- The fight system has been modified; it is now possible to block blows when running out of air.
- Bug fixes have been fixed at the end of each round, such as cutting out "block broken" or "out of breath" states.

notes.title: Note Update 05-27-2024
notes.content:
Note Update 05-27-2024:

- Visual improvements are made in:

[list]
[*] The gym is remodeled with more colors and objects to set the mood.
[*] Sprite images and menu composition.
[*] Initial and final presentation is added in sparrings.
[*] Critical hits received blur vision for a second.
[/list]

- Improvements are made to the game:

[list]
[*] The character's interaction with the gym and his companions is modified.
[*] The type of camera in the gym is changed.
[*] The training to dodge in sparring is modified, now a combination of buttons must be performed to be successful.
[*] The board shows the player's statistics for their next fight.
[*] Depending on the training you have before sparring, you will be able to know your health status and that of your rival in combat.
[/list]

- The character's interaction with the gym and his companions is modified.
- The type of camera in the gym is changed.

tags.balance_change: - The training to dodge in sparring is modified, now a combination of buttons must be performed to be successful.

tags.feature: - The board shows the player's statistics for their next fight.
- Depending on the training you have before sparring, you will be able to know your health status and that of your rival in combat.
